+"""RoboPaint episode controller for the rcb-limited/2.0 service."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+import json, math, pathlib, sys

+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)

+def line_poses(a, b, step=0.002):
+    a=np.asarray(a,dtype=float); b=np.asarray(b,dtype=float)
+    n=max(1,int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b[:3]-a[:3])/step)))
+    return np.array([a+(b-a)*(i/n) for i in range(1,n+1)],dtype=np.float32)
+
+def path_poses(points, step=0.002):
+    out=[]
+    for a,b in zip(points[:-1],points[1:]): out.extend(line_poses(a,b,step))
+    return np.asarray(out,dtype=np.float32)
+
+def run_poses(r, poses, tag, dt=.05, cameras=("canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam")):
+    poses=np.asarray(poses,dtype=np.float32)
+    saved=[]
+    for i in range(0,len(poses),350):
+        res=r.submit("ee_pose",poses[i:i+350],dt=dt,cameras=cameras,video="mp4",note=tag)
+        p=OUT/f"{tag}_{i//350:02d}"; res.save(str(p)); saved.append(str(p))
+        print(json.dumps({"tag":tag,"chunk":i//350,"rows":len(poses[i:i+350]),"meta":res.meta},default=lambda x: x.tolist() if isinstance(x,np.ndarray) else str(x)))
+        if res.done: break
+    return saved
+
+def current_pose(obs): return np.array(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14],dtype=np.float32)
+
+def main():
+    mode=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else "practice"
+    r=Robot(); obs=r.get_obs(cameras=("canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"),video="none")
+    print("START",json.dumps({"time_left_s":obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),"pose":obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]},default=float))
+    p=current_pose(obs)
+    if mode=="practice":
+        # Dip well inside the stone, below its liquid surface, then move to practice.
+        dip=np.array([-0.100,0.150,0.025,*Q_DOWN])
+        pre=np.array([-0.100,0.150,0.080,*Q_DOWN])
+        seq=path_poses([p, np.array([p[0],p[1],.105,*Q_DOWN]), pre, dip], .002)
+        run_poses(r,seq,"calibration_dip")
+        obs=r.get_obs(cameras=("canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"),video="none")
+        p=current_pose(obs)
+        # Travel high to the practice sheet, test a 40 mm horizontal line at light pressure.
+        safe=np.array([-0.100,-0.1856,.080,*Q_DOWN])
+        contact=np.array([-0.100,-0.1656,.018,*Q_DOWN])
+        start=np.array([-0.100,-0.2056,.018,*Q_DOWN])
+        seq=path_poses([p, np.array([p[0],p[1],.105,*Q_DOWN]), np.array([-.100,-.2056,.080,*Q_DOWN]), start, contact], .0015)
+        run_poses(r,seq,"practice_line")
+        # Lift clear and capture the test result.
+        obs=r.get_obs(cameras=("canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"),video="none")
+        p=current_pose(obs)
+        seq=path_poses([p,np.array([p[0],p[1],.085,*Q_DOWN])],.002)
+        run_poses(r,seq,"practice_lift")
+        obs=r.get_obs(cameras=("canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"),video="none")
+        from PIL import Image
+        for cam,img in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(OUT/f"practice_check_{cam}.png")
+        print("CHECK",json.dumps({"time_left_s":obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),"pose":obs.meta["proprio"]["now"],"saved":str(OUT)},default=float))
+        return
+    raise ValueError(f"unknown phase {mode}")
+
+if __name__=="__main__": main()
